# hivelocity_product_operating_systems (Data Source)

Lists the operating systems that can be installed on a product. Use the `name` values for `os_name` on `hivelocity_bare_metal_device` and `hivelocity_vps`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_product_operating_systems" "plan" {
  product_id = 580
}

output "os_names" {
  value = data.hivelocity_product_operating_systems.plan.operating_systems[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) ID of the product.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `operating_systems` (List of Object) Available operating systems. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_init` (Boolean)
- `currency` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `monthly_price` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `post_install` (Boolean)
- `ssh_key` (Boolean)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `upgrade_name` (String)
